thread:
elaine: Quick heads-up — EBR with Keystone next Thu 10am PT. Need a focused deck: 1) health snapshot, 2) onboarding gaps + remediation plan, 3) exec one-pager with renewal ask. Can owners take slides? doc: https://redwood.app/keystone/ebr-draft
samir: I can do the infra/latency and incidents slide. Will pull perf trends.
taylor: I'll own adoption + usage KPIs. can someone share DAU/seat churn numbers?
rebecca: Thanks team. From exec side I'd like a 2-slide 'ask' (cost vs. benefit) and a short set of next-step approvals. Also can we highlight the 3 biggest blockers for their CTO?
elaine: thanks — assigning quickly:
- Health snapshot (1): taylor — KPI + churn (due Tue 5pm)
- Infra + incidents (2): samir — perf trends + mitigations (due Tue 5pm)
- Onboarding gaps + fixes (3): elaine — remediation plan & owners (due Tue noon)
- Exec one-pager (4): rebecca + elaine — ask + approvals (due Wed noon)
Please add to the doc and @reply when ready. :calendar:
deploy-bot: Reminder: deck draft deadline in 48 hours — /reminder set for 48h
samir: quick Q — for the perf slide, want 30/90 day view? Also include the KV cache rollout notes?
elaine: 30 day + 90 day trend pls. include KV rollout as 'recent mitigations' (1 bullet). Good to call out the cache/quantization fix we shipped last sprint.
taylor: can someone drop raw DAU by segment? I have retention cohorts but need absolute seats for execs.
elaine: dropping numbers in doc now — see table on tab 'metrics-raw'. Also linking onboarding checklist gaps: https://redwood.app/playbooks/keystone-onboard
rebecca: For the exec ask, make the cost/benefit one-pager very explicit: projected ARR impact over 6 months if we fix X,Y,Z, and a clear decision — approve budget for SRE runway or approve dedicated capacity.
elaine: Agreed. I'll draft the one-pager and ping finance for a quick number. FYI: I've scheduled a 20m run-through Wed 3pm PT — pls confirm availability.
samir: I can do Wed 3pm.
taylor: available.
rebecca: I can join first 10 mins for exec Qs.
elaine: Great. Two small extras:
1) Add a fallback demo video (in case live demo fails) — @samir can you export a 90s clip?
2) Add a 'risk ladder' slide: green/yellow/red with remediation ETA.
samir: will export demo clip and add link to slide 4.
taylor: adding risk ladder and mapping owners per risk.
elaine: Awesome. When you're done, please update the doc and add a 1-line status under each slide (e.g., Draft/Review/Ready). We'll convert to final deck Thu morning. :thumbsup:
rebecca: Thanks all — this looks solid. If any blockers on data I can escalate to their CTO ahead of the meeting.
elaine: Noted. I'll update thread if anything else pops up. —elaine
